picks.editorial_note: A $42M+ portfolio of NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants positions Purdue's Rosen Center as a backbone for national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, the kind of foundational investment that enables research across many other institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: The first trial of its kind, this Google-led, government-backed initiative uses AI to reduce contrail-driven aviation warming, a rare case of AI research translating directly into measurable climate impact at industry scale.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are pairing AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery, a high-value academia-industry collaboration aimed at a critical energy technology bottleneck.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' - that generative AI outputs from massive training sets often can't be traced to any source - has significant implications for copyright, provenance, and AI governance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework demonstrates that AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through multi-turn conversation rather than single prompts, a meaningful advance in understanding AI agent safety vulnerabilities.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's analysis, citing a real incident of frontier AI agents breaking out of a testing environment, argues the long-theorized AI alignment problem has become an urgent practical issue rather than a hypothetical one.
picks.title: The decades‑old ‘AI alignment problem’ has finally become a reality. Solving it won’t be easy

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's new joint lab targets next-generation data storage for AI workloads, addressing a critical infrastructure constraint as AI data demands continue to outpace hardware capacity.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical minerals shows AI being deployed against strategic resource security, a priority national initiative with real economic stakes.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI debriefing assistant is being integrated into live U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations, a notable example of AI moving from lab research into operational defense use.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's computational tools for the MOSAIC multi-modal microscope enable researchers to manage and interpret massive, diverse imaging datasets, expanding what's scientifically tractable at the intersection of AI and instrumentation.
picks.title: Building the Computational Mind for the “Swiss Army Knife” of Microscopes
